note: v16.2.1 is the release to install, and it changes ONLY sost-cli: sost-node and sost-miner are byte-identical to v16.2.0 (same published hashes), so a node or miner already on v16.2.0 replaces just the CLI and never restarts. The update window is unchanged and still the one to follow - node AND miner, after block #29,900 and before #30,000. What the CLI fixes came out of an audit of the money paths: rpc_call could not read a large answer (it stopped at a buffer that happened to end in '}' whenever it did not find a literal 'Content-Length: ' header - and header names are case-insensitive, and a gateway in front of a node answers chunked with no Content-Length at all), 'send' bypassed it entirely with its own socket and a single 4 KB read, and balances, UTXO import, broadcast, sendmany, bump-fee, the mempool check and the chain height were all parsed by substring search. All of them now go through the strict parser: 23 call sites, zero remaining 'result' substring searches. A broadcast counts as accepted only when the JSON-RPC result IS a string txid; when an answer cannot be read the wallet leaves the inputs unspent and says 'not confirmed', not 'rejected'. Consensus is unchanged for the third release running: V16 still activates at #30,000 and the first DTD Jackpot V2 is still #30,186.
